name: Transcripts, diplomas and credentials
one_line: The organizational situation of holding the official records an institution issued about a course of study — transcripts, diplomas, degree and completion certificates, enrollment verifications — where the issuing school is the only single-valued academic fact the file can carry, the record spans many courses and many terms at once, and one copy may serve several application or recruiting packets without belonging to any of them.
node_test: Passes on all three legs, against academic.coursework (the Academic schema's default template). Detection signals differ: coursework is evidenced by a course-code-plus-context pair describing the document itself, this situation by issuer-and-attestation structure — a registrar or awarding-body heading, a seal or signature-block caption, a verification or document-id slot, degree-conferral or credit-award language. Recommended dimensions differ, and differ for a reason that is about the material rather than about taste: an official record enumerates many courses across many terms inside one file, so no single subject value and no single term value describes it, and the two dimensions coursework leans on are exactly the two this situation must drop — leaving school then work_type. Privacy rules differ: this is the grade-bearing and credential-bearing corner of the Academic schema, it is the file 00 names as shared across several application packets, and it is the one academic situation whose fallthrough includes Protected Records. None of the three differences is a work type or an extension.

deterministic: an official-record term in a high-weight zone (filename, document title, page-one heading) — official transcript, academic transcript, academic record, statement of results, diploma, degree certificate, enrollment verification — together with a schools-gazetteer hit matched at a word boundary standing in the issuer position (letterhead, page-one heading, seal caption). 00 requires the word-boundary discipline outright: "It should use word-boundary matching rather than substring matching." Neither half is sufficient alone

a registrar, awarding-body or issuer signature block together with a verification, document-id or authenticity slot in a footer or header_footer zone, on a document that also carries a school name in a high-weight zone

a table whose rows each pair a course-code-shaped token with a grade and a credit count, and whose rows span more than one term-shaped token — the structural shape that makes any single subject or term value wrong for the file. 00's own discipline against collapsing terms is the reason this shape matters: "A course code alone should not merge different semesters; course packet identity should include a term when it is available"

degree-conferral or credit-award language in a high-weight zone (a degree name beside a conferral or graduation date, has been awarded, has satisfied the requirements) together with a schools-gazetteer hit in the issuer position

a labelled Student ID, Date Conferred, Cumulative GPA, Credits Earned or Date of Birth slot read from a table cell or form field on a document already carrying a school name — 00's table extraction is what makes the labelled slot readable: "Tables matter because resumes, forms, applications, invoices, and administrative documents often place their most useful information in cells rather than body paragraphs", and a labelled form field is one of 00's reliable and explicit sources

OCR text of a portal or scanned page carrying an official or unofficial transcript heading together with a cumulative grade or credit summary and a school name, where source_type = ocr or image contributed only as a routing signal — 00: "A file with no text should route directly to OCR"

an archive manifest naming credential-shaped members beside no coursework members (a transcript, a diploma, a completion certificate) read without unpacking, which makes the packet's records plausible without making any member's facts writable
needs_llm: a scanned or photographed credential whose OCR recovers the seal caption and the degree line but leaves the issuer line illegible — the model must decide whether an issuer is named at all and must return unknown when it cannot cite one

a record in a language or a national format the deterministic vocabulary does not cover (a marksheet, a statement of results, a Zeugnis, a livret scolaire), where the issuer, the award and the grades are all present but none of the catalogue's terms appear

distinguishing a registrar record from a financial-aid award letter or an admissions decision letter when all three arrive on the same school letterhead with the same signature block and differ only in what the body attests
deciding whether a document titled Certificate was issued by an educational provider for a course of study or by a professional body for a licence — the same page shape carries both

an archive or folder whose members mix credentials with application documents, where the question is whether one packet purpose explains the set or the records stand on their own — 00's own manifest case is the neighbouring one: "A ZIP file named submission.zip may contain a transcript, personal statement, resume, certificate, and form, which is meaningful evidence of a purpose-defined application packet even when the outer archive name is vague"
an unofficial advising printout or degree-audit page whose text lists courses, grades and requirements but carries no issuer attestation of any kind
never_alone: the word transcript in a filename alone. This is the tempting false file for this node in particular: an interview transcript, a deposition transcript, a podcast or lecture caption transcript and an audio_video speech-to-text output all carry the same word, and transcript is also the name of an evidence zone in this product's own extraction shape. The file needs an issuer plus academic-record structure before this situation is plausible
the word certificate or diploma in a filename alone — insurance certificates, professional licences, course-completion certificates from a provider, and award certificates all share the word

a school or university name alone — 00: "A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization"
a seal, crest, watermark or letterhead logo alone, including as an image with no readable text: it attests nothing about what the document says
a verification code, document id or barcode alone with no issuer and no award language — it is an identifier shape, not a record

a bare 4-digit number alone as a conferral year or a term, because 00 warns of "numbers that look like years but are course identifiers, version numbers, build numbers, ZIP codes, or other unrelated values"
a grade-shaped token alone (a letter grade, a GPA-shaped decimal, a credit count in a spreadsheet cell) with no issuer and no course rows around it

membership in an application or recruiting packet, or residence in a packet folder, as proof of target_university on the record itself — 00: "A transcript may be part of several application packets", and its adversarial suite already carries "shared resumes across applications"

source_type or extension alone: text_document, image, ocr, spreadsheet, email and archive membership never make this situation plausible without content evidence, because 00 requires the engine to "treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning"
a same-session download batch as proof that a set of PDFs is one person's credential set — 00: "A session should never be treated as proof of topic"

a parent folder named Transcripts, Diplomas or Records alone, with no member file carrying issuer-plus-award evidence; 00 requires existing structure be read rather than rewritten — "The system learns from existing folders but must not silently reorganize them"
a PDF or DOCX author, creator or producer string naming a school or a records system — "PDF metadata should be treated as supporting evidence, not as truth"

proposed_context_terms_note: Proposals, not design. 00 names five academic context terms as the floor for the course-code rule — "BUSIB 4300 becomes a course fact only when the engine finds a course-code pattern together with academic context such as “syllabus,” “lecture,” “credits,” “instructor,” or “semester.”" — and credits is the one of the five that carries here. The rest are this node's proposal for R6's catalogue and are marked as such; none of them is claimed to appear in 00.
work_types_note: Values of the schema's work_type field, never nodes — 00: "The system may create new values when it sees a new course, project, company, university, or event, but it should not invent new fields automatically." This list deliberately holds only the issued-record values; syllabus, lecture, homework and problem set belong to academic.coursework, gradebook and class roster to academic.teaching, and a provider's own credit ledger to academic.continuing-education. The narrowing is what keeps this row from being a second copy of the coursework template.
grouping_reasons: one person's credential set from one issuing school across several award events — the transcript, the diploma and the enrollment verification that the same registrar issued

one issued record across its copies and re-issues, joined by the universal duplicate_family and version_family rather than by any academic fact: an official PDF, a scan of the paper copy and a portal screenshot of the same record are the same record seen three ways

a credential set assembled for one submission, which is a purpose group owned by the applications or recruiting side and not by this template — 00: "The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent"

membership in several such purpose groups at once without any of them writing a fact onto the record — 00: "A transcript may be part of several application packets" and "A file may validly belong to more than one accepted group". The membership records are multi-valued; the fact set on the file stays one

template.why: The issuing school is the parent that makes the child intelligible here, exactly as 00's parent-context rule requires — "A work type such as Homework 3 is meaningful only after the course is known, and a course code may require the school or term to disambiguate it" — because a folder named Transcript means nothing until the institution that issued it is known, while Columbia/Transcript is complete. subject and term are dropped from the recommendation, and that drop is this template's substance rather than a simplification: an official record enumerates many courses across many terms inside one file, so choosing one course or one term as its folder level would be inventing a value the document does not assert, and 00 already forbids the collapsing move on the neighbouring side — "A course code alone should not merge different semesters; course packet identity should include a term when it is available." instructor is excluded because it is not destination-eligible: "It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension." Time is not first, per 00's rule for this kind of material: "For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders." Optional branch patterns this situation genuinely offers: school then term then work_type where a record does cover exactly one term (a single-term grade report, an enrollment verification naming one term), and a flat school-only branch where a person holds two or three credentials from one school — 00: "The product should not force every branch to use the full template or have the same number of levels" and "a two-file application packet may remain a single folder." The whole of it is a recommendation: "The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions."

privacy_rules: This is the grade-bearing and credential-bearing corner of the Academic schema, and the rule that differs from academic.coursework is what may leave the device. Where a question can be resolved from an issuer heading and an award line, the excerpt sent is that heading and that line — 00: "It should not send full documents where a short heading or OCR excerpt is enough to resolve the question." A grade table is never the excerpt that resolves a routing question.

A record that also carries an identity document's content — a date of birth slot, a national id number, a photograph — co-activates the identity safety placeholder on its own evidence, and 00's protection rule then leads: "A scanned passport, tax statement, medical document, authentication key, or account record should enter a protected state immediately." This template unlocks no deeper filing for such a file.

Surfacing follows 00's interface rule rather than the filing recommendation: a count is safe where a list of names is not — "a visible list of passport filenames on a shared screen may not be." The handling class is P7's and is not assigned here.

collides_with.signal: both carry a school, a term-shaped token and course-code-shaped tokens, and a single course code is one evidence item that supports either. The discriminating evidence: this side needs issuer-and-attestation structure — a registrar or awarding-body heading, a seal or signature block, a verification slot — together with a table of course rows spanning more than one term, so that no single subject or term describes the file; coursework needs one course-term, evidenced by a course-code-plus-context pair describing the document itself. Neither side may take a bare course code. Fixtures: Spring 2026 grade report.pdf sits on this seam, and coursework's own Spring 2026 registration confirmation.pdf sits on the other side of it. Reciprocates the edge academic.coursework already states toward this row.

both can be evidenced by a document titled transcript that lists courses and credits against a person, and by a completion certificate. The discriminating evidence: this side carries registrar language, a seal or verification code, and grades against a degree programme; the continuing-education side carries a provider's own credit ledger for professional reporting, with credit units, no grades and no conferred degree. Reciprocates the edge academic.continuing-education already states toward this row, in its own words.

a score report is an officially issued, seal-and-verification-code-bearing record about a person's study, so the attestation structure is one evidence item supporting both. The discriminating evidence: this side needs an institution that conferred credit or a degree; the testing side is issued by a testing organization, names a test and a score scale, and confers no credit and no degree. A verification code alone discriminates nothing, and neither side may take it.

a certificate naming a person, an issuing organization, a credential title and a validation number is one document shape and one evidence item on both sides. The discriminating evidence: this side needs an educational institution conferring academic credit or a degree, evidenced by a schools-gazetteer hit in the issuer position beside credit or degree language; the licence side is issued by a professional or regulatory body, names a licence or certification title and typically an expiry, and confers no academic credit. Fixture: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Certificate.pdf.

one transcript file sits inside the packet and is legitimately read from both sides, and a single university name on the page is one evidence item supporting either. The discriminating evidence: the packet side needs a target-institution plus admissions-cycle or portal pair; this side needs an issuer attestation naming the school the holder attended. 00 requires the separation to hold downstream too — "an application packet does not silently absorb a document with a conflicting target institution" — and forbids the shortcut this seam invites: "A transcript may be part of several application packets". Fixture: Transcript.pdf.

the same school letterhead, the same signature-block shape and the same registrar-adjacent office name are one evidence item supporting both. The discriminating evidence: this side attests study — conferred credit, grades, a degree; the aid side attests money — grant, loan and disbursement amounts against an aid year. A school letterhead alone decides neither. Fixture: Financial Aid Award Letter 2026-27.pdf.

a diploma or transcript scan carrying a date-of-birth slot, a national id number or a photograph is one evidence item supporting both. The discriminating evidence: the identity side is evidenced by a document whose own purpose is to establish who a person is; this side by a document whose purpose is to attest a course of study. Where both clear, 00's protection rule leads and no deep filing unlocks from this template. Fixture: credentials.zip, whose manifest names a passport beside the credentials.

also_holds_with_note: Left empty deliberately. CONNECTION.md restricts also_holds_with to schema ↔ schema, and the co-holding this situation depends on is already asserted there: academic ↔ college_applications (a transcript keeps school and work_type while a packet supplies purpose and target_university), academic ↔ career (a transcript serving a recruiting process), academic ↔ photos (a photographed diploma), and academic ↔ identity would be the pair the credentials.zip fixture points at. This template states the file-level evidence for those joins through file_examples.also_schema and adds no schema-level edge of its own. Where CONNECTION.md and the dispatch prompt disagree on whether a template may author this edge, CONNECTION wins.

falls_through_to.why: 00's own description is this situation's leftovers almost word for word: "standalone certificates, notices, confirmations, forms, and PDFs that have a durable purpose but no broader group". A diploma that belongs to no accepted packet is exactly that. Fixtures: Official_Transcript_Columbia_2026.pdf, Transcript.pdf, Transfer credit evaluation - Columbia.xlsx, Spring 2026 grade report.pdf, and the two collision fixtures once they are routed away from this template.

00 names credentials in this residual's own definition — "Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials" — and requires the home to behave: it "should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts". The record that also establishes identity lands here rather than in Independent Records, and 00 allows it to surface alone: "Rare but sensitive files such as passports, visas, and legal documents may be surfaced as protected records even when they do not meet a normal group-size threshold." Fixture: credentials.zip, and any grade-bearing scan carrying a date-of-birth or national-id slot.

00: "files whose meaning is partly understood but whose final location requires a future decision" — the shape where work_type resolved and the issuing school did not, which is what a low-confidence OCR of a seal caption leaves behind. Fixtures: scan0043.pdf, Interview transcript - Prof Nakamura 2026-03-04.docx once it is routed away from this template.

00 defines it for "isolated invoices, delivery confirmations, booking records, boarding passes, purchase receipts, event tickets, and similar transactional documents" — a transcript-order confirmation is a transaction about a record, not the record. Fixture: Your official transcript order has been sent.eml.

a portal capture whose OCR yields no issuer and no award line has "no accepted project, trip, application, or event relationship". Fixture: Screenshot 2026-06-02 at 09.12.44.png when its OCR is unusable.

00 keeps a home for "password-protected archives, unreadable documents, damaged files, and unknown formats" and requires the archive rule that produces them — "Password-protected, malformed, nested, or oversized archives should be marked as unreadable or partially inspected rather than forced open". Fixture: credentials.zip while it stays locked, where 00's safer option applies: represent it without moving it.

a photographed credential with camera EXIF and no readable text has "no event, project, reference collection, or photo-family association" on the academic side. Fixture: IMG_3390.HEIC before OCR resolves anything.

role_split.why: The split this template lives on. The school that issued the record and the institution the record is being sent to are the same entity type in different roles, and on a transcript inside a packet both are in the room at once. 00 requires the separation — "The system must separate roles that happen to contain the same entity type" — and names the consequence for this exact file: "A transcript may be part of several application packets", so packet membership never fills target_university on the record. The canonical field list already records the pair; this row references it rather than minting anything.

The same split stated against the schema that owns the addressed-institution role, so the join is expressible whether a consumer resolves through the packet template or through its schema. 00's own wording for the pair is "distinct facets, such as authored_by and target_school"; both keys are already canonical and neither is created here.

sensitivity_why: 00 counts this material in the corpus it protects twice over. Once by name in the privacy sentence: the product "processes a highly personal corpus that can include identity documents, account statements, tax records, medical information, legal records, credentials, private correspondence, GPS metadata, employment materials, and educational records" — a transcript is an educational record and a diploma is a credential. And once in the residual library, where credentials are listed among the "sensitive isolated material" Protected Records exists for. What differs from academic.coursework is concentration rather than kind: a transcript carries the holder's whole grade history in one page, and a scanned credential often carries a date of birth and a photograph beside it. Which handling class applies is P7's and is not set here.
open_question: Where is a transcript's primary home when it belongs to several application or recruiting packets and carries no institution-specific fact of its own? 00 poses the question and hands it to the user rather than answering it — the frozen tree "should therefore include a policy for shared material: a shared branch, a primary-home convention, a reference or alias convention, or mandatory review", it names Applications/Shared Application Materials as one such branch, and it forbids the system from choosing: "If no shared branch exists, the system should not arbitrarily choose one university. It should abstain or ask the user to choose a primary home." The fork this node cannot settle is whether the default offered home for the credential set is this template's Academics branch (the record's issuer) or the Applications shared-materials branch (the record's use), because the answer decides what a user sees before they have expressed any preference. Joseph's call.
